items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A collapsible panel: a pointer clicks the header, the chevron turns and the content unfolds, then it closes again.

items.name: accordion-unfold
items.title: Accordion Unfold
items.description: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host prints its own logo by replacing the .au-print contents in the script.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent Run
items.description: A brand-neutral AI agent run that thinks, calls tools against a real-seconds timer and streams a markdown answer in bursts.

items.name: ai-prompt-flow
items.title: AI Prompt Flow
items.description: A full prompt-to-answer scene: the prompt types itself, the button runs to loading, a skeleton shimmers, the answer crossfades in and a toast confirms.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A destructive confirmation: a pointer clicks Delete account, a dimmed alert dialog scales in and the Delete button is pressed.

items.name: anamorphic-flare
items.title: Anamorphic Flare
items.description: A point of light stretches into a cinematic horizontal streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo behind it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .af-logo element.

items.name: animated-line-chart
items.title: Animated Line Chart
items.description: A line chart whose path draws on from left to right with a glowing leading dot.

items.name: ascii-dissolve
items.title: ASCII Dissolve
items.description: The frame turns into plain text: a field of monospace characters rises over the outgoing scene, flows as living ASCII, then dissolves cell by cell into the incoming scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .asd-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: backdrop
items.title: Backdrop
items.description: Full-frame colour or gradient fill with a padded, rounded, shadowed content frame (the floating-card look). Frame holds a built-in placeholder.

items.name: bauhaus-build
items.title: Bauhaus Build
items.description: Geometric Bauhaus pieces tumble in, snap into a composition, then tumble away again.

items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: A product wipes left to right into a technical drawing with a blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines and a red callout. A built-in red device stands in for the product; labels and colors are variables.

items.name: brick-mosaic
items.title: Brick Mosaic
items.description: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a small bounce and build a pixel-art image on a baseplate. Give it a pixel-art grid as text in the pattern variable, or leave it empty for a built-in red disc.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button that plays its whole lifecycle: a pointer arrives, the button hovers, presses, shows a spinner, then a check.

items.name: caption-active-pop
items.title: Caption Active Pop
items.description: The word being spoken turns to the accent color and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-blur-in
items.title: Caption Blur In
items.description: Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly.

items.name: caption-bounce-in
items.title: Caption Bounce In
items.description: Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word.

items.name: caption-cube
items.title: Caption Cube
items.description: Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge.

items.name: caption-dim-progress
items.title: Caption Dim Progress
items.description: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.

items.name: caption-drop
items.title: Caption Drop
items.description: Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-emoji
items.title: Caption Emoji
items.description: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.

items.name: caption-handwrite
items.title: Caption Handwrite
items.description: Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle.

items.name: caption-highlight-box
items.title: Caption Highlight Box
items.description: A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-karaoke
items.title: Caption Karaoke
items.description: Each word fills with color left to right exactly as it is spoken, with the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.

items.name: caption-knockout
items.title: Caption Knockout
items.description: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.

items.name: caption-label-maker
items.title: Caption Label Maker
items.description: Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive.

items.name: caption-marker
items.title: Caption Marker
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-outline
items.title: Caption Outline
items.description: Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast color and nothing else moving.

items.name: caption-prosody
items.title: Caption Prosody
items.description: Word size follows the delivery: drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, so the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off.

items.name: caption-redact
items.title: Caption Redact
items.description: The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken.

items.name: caption-rise
items.title: Caption Rise
items.description: Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale.

items.name: caption-scramble
items.title: Caption Scramble
items.description: Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters.

items.name: caption-slice
items.title: Caption Slice
items.description: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caption-slot
items.title: Caption Slot
items.description: One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top.

items.name: caption-speaker
items.title: Caption Speaker
items.description: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's color, so a conversation reads like a script.

items.name: caption-split-flap
items.title: Caption Split Flap
items.description: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.

items.name: caption-stack
items.title: Caption Stack
items.description: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.

items.name: caption-stamp
items.title: Caption Stamp
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-subtitle
items.title: Caption Subtitle
items.description: Classic broadcast subtitles: a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all.

items.name: caption-teleprompter
items.title: Caption Teleprompter
items.description: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.

items.name: caption-timeline
items.title: Caption Timeline
items.description: The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words.

items.name: caption-typewriter
items.title: Caption Typewriter
items.description: Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-underline
items.title: Caption Underline
items.description: A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched.

items.name: caption-weight
items.title: Caption Weight
items.description: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.

items.name: caption-word-pop
items.title: Caption Word Pop
items.description: One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caret
items.title: Caret
items.description: A blinking text caret: a thin rounded bar that flips on and off, sitting after a line of text.

items.name: caret-wipe
items.title: Caret Wipe
items.description: A tall text caret sweeps across the frame: behind it the new scene is typed in, ahead of it the old scene is backspaced away. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .crw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: centered-word-build
items.title: Centered Word Build
items.description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes closer on every beat.

items.name: chat-flow
items.title: Chat Flow
items.description: A messaging conversation: outgoing messages type into the composer and send, typing dots precede replies, and reactions pop onto bubbles.

items.name: chat-to-preview-layout
items.title: Chat to Preview Layout
items.description: A two-up split where the chat panel shrinks and the preview panel expands, to show an agent building something. Both panels hold generic placeholder content. On a tall frame the split stacks vertically (chat on top).

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check List
items.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out, then ticks and strikes through every done item.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that a pointer ticks and unticks: the box fills with the primary color and the check draws in.

items.name: checkout-flow
items.title: Checkout Flow
items.description: A cursor-driven checkout card: pick the yearly plan, type a card number, accept the terms, pay, and a toast confirms.

items.name: chromatic-wave
items.title: Chromatic Wave
items.description: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes, then settle back to white.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select: the panel opens, a query types itself, the list narrows, and the matching row is picked.

items.name: comic-panels
items.title: Comic Panels
items.description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines and halftone, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame word such as POW. A built-in lockup stands in for the hero; a host replaces the contents of the .cp-hero layer with its own logo or headline.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A keyboard-driven command palette: the backdrop dims, a query types itself, the list filters, and the first row is picked.

items.name: command-menu-item
items.title: Command Menu Item
items.description: One command palette row going idle, hover, press and selected as the cursor reaches it and clicks.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that opens at the cursor over a file card, then an item is hovered, pressed and the menu closes.

items.name: crumple-toss
items.title: Crumple Toss
items.description: A card crumples into a paper wad in stop-motion poses and is tossed into a bin: the old way, thrown away.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: An animated mouse pointer that follows a scripted path to a button, clicks it with a ripple, and the button shows hover, press, loading and success.

items.name: cursor-gravity
items.title: Cursor Gravity
items.description: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog: a pointer clicks a trigger, the scrim dims the frame and the dialog scales in; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: dither-dissolve
items.title: Dither Dissolve
items.description: A two-color ordered-dither pattern rises over the outgoing scene, holds, and falls away to reveal the next one. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D Bayer dither instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .dtd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: dolly-zoom
items.title: Dolly Zoom
items.description: The vertigo shot: a corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the middle keeps its exact size. A host puts its own subject in by replacing the .dz-subject svg with its own centered content.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom panel: a pointer clicks a trigger inside a mock app window, the scrim dims it and a drawer rises from the bottom; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: drift
items.title: Drift
items.description: A slow constant camera push-in, so no scene is ever frozen. Plays on a built-in placeholder scene.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: An action menu: a pointer clicks the trigger, the menu drops open, a row is hovered and pressed, then the menu closes.

items.name: dropdown-menu-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Item
items.description: A menu row: a pointer hovers it and presses it, inside a small action menu.

items.name: duotone-beat
items.title: Duotone Beat
items.description: A two-ink halftone portrait that swaps its ink pair on every beat, punches in on the downbeat and shows a bar indicator. A built-in silhouette stands in for the photo; a host replaces the contents of the .db-picture layer with its own image.

items.name: echo-stack
items.title: Echo Stack
items.description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

items.name: ecosystem-constellation
items.title: Ecosystem Constellation
items.description: A central product mark orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines. The eight satellites are generic placeholder marks, not real brands.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded View
items.description: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.

items.name: extrude-pop
items.title: Extrude Pop
items.description: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labelled form field: a label above, an input that focuses and types, helper text below, and a second filled field in the same group.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Flow Field
items.description: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded, slowly changing vector field and leave fine fading trails, as a seamless loop.

items.name: focus-pull
items.title: Focus Pull
items.description: A rack focus between scenes: the outgoing scene defocuses and brightens, the incoming scene pulls into sharp focus. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .fcp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: fog-rise
items.title: Fog Rise
items.description: Display text resolves out of fog center-out, sharpening from heavy blur as it tilts up on a spring.

items.name: glass-code-block
items.title: Glass Code Block
items.description: A frosted-glass code editor window with a small regex colouring (plain spans, no highlighter library) and a line-by-line stagger reveal. Transparent, so it composites over any background.

items.name: glass-code-walk
items.title: Glass Code Walk
items.description: A camera that scans a frosted-glass code block top to bottom as its lines appear, then pulls back to a centred hold.

items.name: glyph-anatomy
items.title: Glyph Anatomy
items.description: A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill.

items.name: gooey-morph
items.title: Gooey Morph
items.description: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, then melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.

items.name: gradient-scale-cut-text
items.title: Gradient Scale Cut Text
items.description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a compact blurred line that settles into focus.

items.name: grain-dissolve
items.title: Grain Dissolve
items.description: A grainy gradient field blurs the outgoing scene away, fills the frame, and then clears to reveal the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .grd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: gravity-pile
items.title: Gravity Pile
items.description: Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap, with optional words or emoji of your own landing on top.

items.name: hand-count
items.title: Hand Count
items.description: A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose.

items.name: handwrite
items.title: Handwrite
items.description: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock.

items.name: hyperspace
items.title: Hyperspace
items.description: A jump to lightspeed: stars stretch into streaks around the outgoing scene, which is pushed toward the camera, then a white flash cuts to the incoming scene while the last streaks fade. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .hsp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.description: An animated activity icon: the strokes draw in, then it plays its signature motion.

items.name: icon-zap
items.title: Zap Icon
items.description: An animated zap icon: the strokes draw in, then it plays its signature motion.

items.name: impact-shake
items.title: Impact Shake
items.description: Heavy content slams down from above with a squash, a damped camera jolt, a two-frame RGB split and dust puffs kicking out sideways. The built-in subject is a big word; a host puts its own content in by replacing the .is-word elements.

items.name: infinite-bento-pan
items.title: Infinite Bento Pan
items.description: A hypnotic diagonal camera glide over an oversized grid of bento cards (charts, counters, code, gradients) with a vignette. All figures are filler.

items.name: infinite-marquee
items.title: Infinite Marquee
items.description: A continuously scrolling horizontal text strip that loops seamlessly.

items.name: inflate
items.title: Inflate
items.description: A flat sliver puffs up like a balloon toy, squashes and settles into a glossy mark, then the wordmark slides out. The mark is a fixed rounded square with a dot; the wordmark is the text variable.

items.name: ink-arrow
items.title: Ink Arrow
items.description: A hand-drawn arrow that draws itself from one point to another in stop-motion poses.

items.name: ink-underline
items.title: Ink Underline
items.description: A hand-dragged ink stroke that draws itself across in a few stop-motion poses.

items.name: inline-pill-takeover
items.title: Inline Pill Takeover
items.description: A clipped pill expands inside a sentence, pushes the words apart, and takes over the frame.

items.name: inline-word-roll
items.title: Inline Word Roll
items.description: Switch words beside a fixed prefix with an accelerating vertical roll; the whole line recenters as word lengths change.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field that plays its states: a pointer hovers and clicks it, it focuses with a ring, the value types in, then the field shows an invalid state.

items.name: iris-wipe
items.title: Iris Wipe
items.description: A classic iris: the outgoing scene closes to a small dot on a solid color, then the incoming scene opens from the same point. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .irw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: isometric-build
items.title: Isometric Build
items.description: An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds.

items.name: keystroke
items.title: Keystroke
items.description: Physical keycaps rise and press to show keyboard shortcuts, one chord after another.

items.name: kinetic-morph-text
items.title: Kinetic Morph Text
items.description: Letters lift, rotate, and reshape into the next phrase with delicate outline trails.

items.name: kinetic-warp
items.title: Kinetic Warp
items.description: A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis moving per keyframe.

items.name: lens-zoom
items.title: Lens Zoom
items.description: A fast fisheye lens push: the outgoing scene bulges and zooms into the lens with motion blur, a camera shake and a slight color fringe, then the incoming scene unwinds out of the same lens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .lz-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: life-grid
items.title: Life Grid
items.description: Conway's Game of Life runs on a seeded grid, newborn cells flashing in the accent and dying cells shrinking away.

items.name: line-boil
items.title: Line Boil
items.description: A hand-drawn outline draws itself, boils on threes like a cel animation, and fills with color while it keeps boiling. Takes any closed outline as SVG path data in the path variable (default: a five-point star).

items.name: liquid-fill
items.title: Liquid Fill
items.description: A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing surface and bubbles until the mark is solid. Give it any closed shape as the shape path variable.

items.name: live-code-compilation
items.title: Live Code Compilation
items.description: Split screen: code is typed on the left and the button on the right snaps to match on the exact frame each property finishes. On a tall frame the split stacks (code on top, preview below).

items.name: logo-enter
items.title: Logo Enter
items.description: A stacked, overlapping group of round chips that spring in one by one, then hold. Ships with generic placeholder marks; set the chip count and colours to match your own.

items.name: long-shadow
items.title: Long Shadow
items.description: A flat icon pops in and casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring. A built-in check badge stands in for the mark; a host replaces the contents of the .ls-mark layers with its own flat icon.

items.name: mask-reveal-up
items.title: Mask Reveal Up
items.description: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: A speech bubble that pops in, with an optional reaction badge that springs onto its corner.

items.name: micro-scale-fade
items.title: Micro Scale Fade
items.description: A calm, tiny scale pop for subtle premium polish on labels and headings.

items.name: mondrian-split
items.title: Mondrian Split
items.description: A De Stijl grid draws itself line by line, fills with primary colors, and one cell expands to take over the frame.

items.name: neon-sign
items.title: Neon Sign
items.description: A glass neon tube stutters alive segment by segment, buzzes off once, then holds lit with a glow on the wall. Replace the path variable with your own monoline SVG path.

items.name: orbit-lock
items.title: Orbit Lock
items.description: Moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a core that bursts into a ring flash, and the logo springs into place. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .ol-logo element.

items.name: outline-fill-track-text
items.title: Outline Fill Track Text
items.description: A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills as one continuous track moves left.

items.name: outline-trace
items.title: Outline Trace
items.description: Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it.

items.name: page-turn
items.title: Page Turn
items.description: The outgoing scene lifts off like a page and rotates up out of the frame in a few stepped poses, uncovering the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pgt-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: paper-sticker
items.title: Paper Sticker
items.description: Taped paper chips that slap onto a stop-motion scene over two poses, one after another.

items.name: paper-tear
items.title: Paper Tear
items.description: The outgoing scene is printed on paper that strains, rips down the middle with a jolt of the camera and a flash, and is flung apart in two torn halves with flying scraps, revealing the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ptr-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: paper-wobble
items.title: Paper Wobble
items.description: Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk.

items.name: parallax-depth
items.title: Parallax Depth
items.description: A layered landscape trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones. Built-in sun and hills preview on their own; a host adds its own full-frame layers by pushing an element and a depth (1 is nearest, larger moves less) onto LAYERS in the script.

items.name: path-ride
items.title: Path Ride
items.description: A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline.

items.name: pendulum-wave
items.title: Pendulum Wave
items.description: A row of pendulums drifts out of phase into waves, then snaps back into a straight line.

items.name: per-character-rise
items.title: Per Character Rise
items.description: Letters slide up from below with no blur, one after another: crisp and kinetic.

items.name: period-drop
items.title: Period Drop
items.description: A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period.

items.name: perlin-dissolve
items.title: Perlin Dissolve
items.description: Organic noise grows over the outgoing scene until the frame is flooded with one color, then the incoming scene fades in. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .prd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: perspective-squeeze
items.title: Perspective Squeeze
items.description: Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes.

items.name: phyllotaxis
items.title: Phyllotaxis
items.description: Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then one Fibonacci arm turns accent and pulses outward while the head slowly turns.

items.name: pixel-sort
items.title: Pixel Sort
items.description: The outgoing scene melts downward in vertical columns of different speeds, smeared into bright streaks, and the incoming scene drops in column by column and snaps sharp. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pxs-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: polaroid
items.title: Polaroid
items.description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption. The photo is a built-in live placeholder (a drifting sunrise gradient); layer your own video or image over the photo window to use it.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A hover card that opens above a mention chip as the cursor arrives, then closes when it leaves.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar that fills along a scripted value: a fast start, a stall, then a finish.

items.name: push-through
items.title: Push Through
items.description: The outgoing scene is pushed toward the camera and blurs away while the next scene arrives from behind it. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pth-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: puzzle-snap
items.title: Puzzle Snap
items.description: Geometric pieces spin in from scattered positions and snap into a mark with sparks, then the wordmark slides out beside it. The mark is a fixed set of shapes; the wordmark is the text variable.

items.name: radial-burst
items.title: Radial Burst
items.description: A dot launches rounded ribbons that curl into a ring, spin shut and sweep out of frame in a bold geometric burst.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A radio that a pointer selects: the ring takes the primary color and the dot scales in.

items.name: reel
items.title: Reel
items.description: A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last. Five CSS-drawn placeholder screens stand in for your shots: a host swaps its own images in by replacing the contents of each .rl-shot with an img (object-fit cover).

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: A two-panel split whose divider is grabbed by the cursor and dragged right, left, then back to the middle.

items.name: ring-text
items.title: Ring Text
items.description: Text runs around a tilted 3D band that spins, reading on the near side and mirrored on the far side.

items.name: ripple-zoom
items.title: Ripple Zoom
items.description: Rings of color ripple out and zoom past the camera while the outgoing scene swells away and the incoming scene scales up out of the pattern. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .rpz-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: riso-print
items.title: Riso Print
items.description: Print a subject in two risograph inks, with the accent plate sliding in off-register and settling a hair out of alignment over grainy paper. A built-in geometric poster stands in for the subject; a host replaces the contents of both .rp-subject layers with its own picture.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.

items.name: rolodex-flip
items.title: Rolodex Flip
items.description: Cycle a word through a list of values inside a held line, with a 3D rolodex card flip.

items.name: scale-down-fade
items.title: Scale Down Fade
items.description: Subtle premium settle-in with a restrained scale-down fade on exit.

items.name: scribble-circle
items.title: Scribble Circle
items.description: A hand-drawn marker circle scribbles itself around a target in stop-motion poses.

items.name: search-reveal
items.title: Search Reveal
items.description: Construction circles expand into a search field, type your product name, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select box: a pointer clicks the trigger, the option panel drops open, an option is hovered, pressed and committed with a check, then the panel closes.

items.name: select-item
items.title: Select Item
items.description: A selectable option row: a pointer hovers it, presses it, and it commits as selected with a check, inside a small option list.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select Menu
items.description: A vertical option list: a highlight glides down to an option as the pointer follows it, presses it and commits it with a check, then fades back.

items.name: selection-snap
items.title: Selection Snap
items.description: A thin word in a loose viewfinder snaps into a design-tool selection while it goes from Thin to Black, pops its handles and counts up a size badge.

items.name: shader-spiral-pass
items.title: Shader Spiral Pass
items.description: A neon spiral tunnel swallows the outgoing scene, the camera dives through its center, and an expanding aperture reveals the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D tunnel instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ssp-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: shadow-sweep-text
items.title: Shadow Sweep Text
items.description: A rising line is uncovered and removed by two dense dark shadow sweeps.

items.name: sheen-slide-in
items.title: Sheen Slide In
items.description: A title glides in from the right with a long settle while a gradient sheen sweeps through the glyphs.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel: a pointer clicks a trigger inside a mock app window, the scrim dims it and a panel slides in from the right; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: short-slide-down
items.title: Short Slide Down
items.description: Words drop in from above and stack into a centered multi-line composition.

items.name: short-slide-right
items.title: Short Slide Right
items.description: The whole phrase glides in from the left while words reveal in sequence through opacity.

items.name: simulated-cursor
items.title: Simulated Cursor
items.description: A synthetic mouse cursor that travels between waypoints and fires a click ripple, for narrating a UI on screen.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A shimmer placeholder that crossfades to the real content once it has loaded.

items.name: skeleton-block
items.title: Skeleton Block
items.description: A single shimmer placeholder rectangle whose highlight sweeps across it on a 2 second loop.

items.name: slide-swap
items.title: Slide Swap
items.description: Scenes swap on one canvas, never overlapping: the old scene is shoved off under power and the next one springs in and brakes into place. Plays three scenes (A, B, C). Built-in placeholder scenes A, B and C (the three .ssw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it with your own scenes, replace the contents of those panels (each holds for 70 frames) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb is picked up by the cursor and dragged from 20 to 80, with hover and press states on the thumb.

items.name: smoke-dissolve
items.title: Smoke Dissolve
items.description: A ring of smoke expands from the center of the frame and the incoming scene materializes out of it. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .smd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Comic-style motion streaks: a squashing ball leaves a trail as it lands, or rays rush out from a focus point.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A deterministic spinning arc: a rounded stroke that turns once every 60 frames at speed 1.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A soft stage spotlight searches the dark, overshoots, lands on the logo, and the house lights come up. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .sp-logo element.

items.name: spring-scale-in
items.title: Spring Scale In
items.description: Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a spring settling into place.

items.name: spring-settle
items.title: Spring Settle
items.description: Scenes leave as one group, shrinking and fading, then the stage changes color on an empty beat and the next scene's items spring in staggered from slightly oversized. Plays three scenes (A, B, C). Built-in placeholder scenes A, B and C (the three .ssl-scene elements, whose .ssl-item children settle in one after another) make it preview on its own; to use it with your own scenes, replace the contents of those scenes, give the elements that should settle in the class ssl-item, and set each scene's stage color in the SCENES list in the script.

items.name: squeeze-in
items.title: Squeeze In
items.description: Characters are uncovered one by one by a clean wipe, then the whole word squeezes tighter as the last one lands.

items.name: squiggle
items.title: Squiggle
items.description: A wavy, zigzag, looping or coiled line draws itself with a springy swim, settles, holds and erases.

items.name: stage
items.title: Stage
items.description: A long page on a perspective studio plane, with the camera travelling across it on keyframes. The plane holds a built-in placeholder page drawn in CSS; to use your own, replace the markup inside #st-page in the file (it is 1265 wide and 5000 tall, scaled to the plane).

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step progress indicator: circles fill, check marks draw and connectors fill as the position advances.

items.name: stretch-in
items.title: Stretch In
items.description: Letters fly in from off-canvas and smear horizontally on the way: a vertex-lag deformation, not a scale.

items.name: string-art
items.title: String Art
items.description: Threads are strung around a ring of pins as a times table, then the multiplier morphs the figure from a cardioid through a nephroid and beyond.

items.name: stripe-type
items.title: Stripe Type
items.description: A word cut into horizontal bands, as in the IBM logo, slides together from alternating sides and locks, then can pass on through.

items.name: swirl-dissolve
items.title: Swirl Dissolve
items.description: A rotating swirl of color bands unwinds to open and winds shut again, and the incoming scene grows out of its center. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .swd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch that a pointer flips: the track fills with the primary color while the thumb slides across.

items.name: synthwave
items.title: Synthwave
items.description: A retro neon horizon with a scrolling perspective grid, a rising striped sun and mountain ranges that slide in. The grid keeps scrolling for as long as the clip lasts.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tab bar: a pointer clicks each tab in turn, the indicator slides to it, the label darkens and the panel text cross-fades.

items.name: terminal-cursor-zoom
items.title: Terminal Cursor Zoom
items.description: Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as one command types at high zoom.

items.name: tiny-planet
items.title: Tiny Planet
items.description: A seeded flat skyline bends into a tiny planet through a polar remap, then keeps turning beside a red sun.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A notification that slides in from below after a button click, holds, then auto-dismisses.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A segmented control whose thumb slides between segments as the cursor clicks Yearly, then Monthly.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small floating label that appears next to a button as the cursor hovers it, then fades away.

items.name: topo-lines
items.title: Topo Lines
items.description: Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and drift, with index contours and one line picked out in the accent, as a seamless loop.

items.name: trim-burst
items.title: Trim Burst
items.description: Short strokes shoot outward from a point and shrink to nothing: a quick spark, pop or impact accent.

items.name: truchet-flip
items.title: Truchet Flip
items.description: A grid of quarter-circle tiles flips in waves, then settles into a clean pattern: rings, a field or a silhouette.

items.name: turntable
items.title: Turntable
items.description: A product card with real thickness spins on an invisible turntable through front, edge and back, with face shading, a moving sheen and a floor shadow. The faces are placeholders; a host puts its own content in the .tt-front and .tt-back markup in the script.

items.name: type-fossil
items.title: Type Fossil
items.description: A readable word carries layers of fine contours, revises itself through earlier drafts, then compresses into a clean typographic imprint.

items.name: type-repeater
items.title: Type Repeater
items.description: An After Effects style repeater on a word, where copies unfold into a tunnel, a spiral or a fan behind it, breathe, then fold back into the word.

items.name: type-wall
items.title: Type Wall
items.description: Rows of one word fill the frame, run in alternating directions at different speeds in heavy, narrow and outline faces, with an accent band through the middle.

items.name: typed-split-wipe
items.title: Typed Split Wipe
items.description: A centered cursorless type build exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes.

items.name: value-swap
items.title: Value Swap
items.description: Swap a value in place with a vertical slide so the layout never shifts.

items.name: venetian-blinds
items.title: Venetian Blinds
items.description: The outgoing scene is cut into horizontal slats that turn edge-on one after another, like blinds opening onto the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .vnb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: warp-dissolve
items.title: Warp Dissolve
items.description: The outgoing scene melts and blurs into a flowing, domain-warped color field that then resolves into the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wpd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: wave-wipe
items.title: Wave Wipe
items.description: A grainy gradient of waves drifts up the frame while the outgoing scene lifts away and the incoming scene rises from the bottom. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wvw-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: word-push
items.title: Word Push
items.description: Words drive in from the right and push the line left into its new center.

items.name: word-stream
items.title: Word Stream
items.description: Voiceover-paced phrases building word by word while the line drifts left.

items.name: x-ray-scan
items.title: X-Ray Scan
items.description: A glowing scanner bar sweeps across a device and reveals its white-line internals, with one part marked in red. A built-in phone stands in for the product; a host replaces the .xr-outside and .xr-inside layers with its own exterior and interior pictures.

items.name: zoom-blur
items.title: Zoom Blur
items.description: A quick cross-zoom: the outgoing scene swells and blurs out while the next scene scales up from slightly small and sharpens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .zmb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: zoom-words
items.title: Zoom Words
items.description: Huge words fade into a long line while the camera rides the write head.
